question: Can an app translate speech live for deaf people?
description: Yes, Live Translator in Captio AI translates speech into another language as it is spoken and shows it on your phone.
Captio AI is made for deaf and hard of hearing people, so a conversation in a language you do not share becomes text instead of sound.
Live Translator in Captio AI shows the translation next to the original captions, so you see both while the person talks.
Live Translator in Captio AI translates speech in 60 languages, on iPhone and Android.
A language hint tells Captio AI which language to expect, so it starts tuned in from the first word.
Captio AI also handles speech that switches languages mid-sentence.

Live Translator in Captio AI helps while travelling, at a doctor's appointment or in an in-person meeting between people with different languages; confirm medical instructions with the doctor or pharmacist.
The free plan of Captio AI gives you 100 free credits a day, and the app is free to download.
Live Translator in Captio AI needs an internet connection, translations can contain mistakes, and it does not replace a professional interpreter.
